items.heading: Step One
items.text: Step one: collect thirty live notices for one role in your city or remote, from several job sites and company pages. Step two: copy each required skill into a spreadsheet, one line per skill per notice. Step three: count how many notices ask for each skill, and mark must-have (in the required list) or bonus.

items.heading: A Skill That Appears
items.text: A skill that appears in many notices and has direct clients is a sign you can sell it. See freelance skills in demand .
